result.question: Who was warned that he would not be buried in his ancestors’ tomb?

readings.answer: the man of God who had come from Judah
readings.support: the man of God who had come from Judah | Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.

assessments.reason: Verse 21 identifies the addressee as “the man of God who had come from Judah,” and verse 22 gives the warning about not being buried with his ancestors, matching “the man of God from Judah.”

result.reason: The text directly states the warning was spoken to the man of God from Judah.
